meta.title: Should you pay over $100 for a belt? Tanner Goods.
meta.description:
Subscribe! Also hey, follow me on instantgram. Seriously, just do it man come on. Just follow me instantgram.

The Tanner Goods standard belt? Is it good? Ever heard of it? It's vegetable tanned english bridal leather, gorgeous! I know. Too good to be true? No. It's real. Better believe it kid. Anyways, why not just go to the mall and buy a $10 Levi's belt and call it a day? That's what I did for a while but then I got more into leather and learned about full grain, and patina, and all the other fixings that people get into these days and suddenly my Levi's belt didn't cut the mustard.

I'm not sure if a belt really counts as EDC but I think I'm going to count it as one. My EDC is pretty low key, basically my phone, wallet and keys.
